about_the_game:
Target Dragon 2: Maze Runner is a single-player fantasy RPG adventure where you battle dragons invading your village. As you progress through six different maps navigating through Dragon’s labyrinths to reach LORD DRAGON, you complete various quests to upgrade your character. During battles with fantastical creatures, you can bring along a loyal pet dog; its automatic attack system lends you extra support by taking care of enemies on your behalf. Additionally, you have the option to nurture a fairy that grants you unique skills, helping to speed up your progress.

While gathering materials by engaging in activities such as mining, woodcutting, flower picking, and fishing, you can utilize the crafting system to refine your resources—further boosted by hiring workers when needed. With the freedom to choose between male and female characters and play as a warrior, archer, or mage, this offline adventure features over 100 mazes, 1000 puzzles, and countless quests waiting for you.
